rationale: This plan synthesizes findings from both prior tasks (T11 portfolio deep-dive and T12 wider-net high-cost model) to create a one-page executive brief for the CFO. The brief includes all required sections: key findings, model performance results, limitations, and next steps. Citations are enabled on all numeric statements to enforce traceability and credibility per skill 006 (enforce_citation_discipline_in_executive_communication). The report includes synthetic_data caveat per skill 001 (document_synthetic_data_limitations_in_all_reports) to protect stakeholder interpretation, and no_operational_use caveat per skill 005 (include_no_operational_use_caveat_in_healthcare_predictive_models) to ensure model scores are understood as analytical-only and require governance review before any operational deployment decisions. The plan respects the 600-word brief limit while maintaining analytical rigor.
